# MIPS32, big endian. Compared against `llvm-mc -triple=mips`.
#
# Reorder mode: rsasm always behaves as `.set noreorder` -- it emits exactly
# the instructions written and never fills a delay slot. llvm-mc defaults to
# `.set reorder`, in which it appends a `nop` after every instruction that has
# a delay slot. Nothing with a delay slot therefore appears in this file;
# branches and jumps live in mips-programs.txt, where a trailing `.p2align`
# makes the two agree (see the note there).
#
# Macro mode: both assemblers expand `li`, `la`, `move` and the ordered
# branches. rsasm has no `.set nomacro`; llvm-mc only warns under it.
#
# Deliberate divergence: `div $rs, $rt` written with two operands is the raw
# DIV instruction here, where llvm-mc expands it into a divide-by-zero trap
# sequence. The three-operand `div $zero, $rs, $rt` spelling is unambiguous
# and is what this corpus uses.

# ---- R-format arithmetic and logic ----
add $1, $2, $3
add $t0, $t1, $t2
add $zero, $at, $v0
add $sp, $fp, $ra
addu $a0, $a1, $a2
addu $30, $29, $28
sub $s0, $s1, $s2
sub $27, $26, $25
subu $v0, $v1, $a0
and $t3, $t4, $t5
or $t6, $t7, $s0
xor $s1, $s2, $s3
nor $s4, $s5, $s6
slt $s7, $t8, $t9
sltu $k0, $k1, $gp
mul $4, $5, $6
movz $4, $5, $6
movn $4, $5, $6

# ---- shifts ----
sll $1, $2, 0
sll $1, $2, 3
sll $1, $2, 31
srl $3, $4, 1
sra $5, $6, 16
sllv $7, $8, $9
srlv $10, $11, $12
srav $13, $14, $15

# ---- multiply, divide, HI/LO ----
mult $4, $5
multu $6, $7
div $zero, $8, $9
divu $zero, $10, $11
madd $4, $5
maddu $4, $5
msub $4, $5
msubu $4, $5
mfhi $16
mflo $17
mthi $18
mtlo $19

# ---- I-format arithmetic ----
addi $4, $5, 0
addi $4, $5, -1
addi $4, $5, 32767
addi $4, $5, -32768
addiu $a0, $a1, 100
addiu $a0, $a1, -100
addiu $4, $5, 0xffff
slti $4, $5, -1
sltiu $4, $5, 1000
andi $4, $5, 0
andi $4, $5, 0xffff
ori $4, $5, 0x1234
xori $4, $5, 0xabcd
lui $4, 0
lui $4, 0xffff
lui $at, 0x1234

# ---- loads and stores ----
lb $4, 0($5)
lb $4, -1($5)
lbu $4, 1($5)
lh $4, 2($5)
lhu $4, 4($5)
lw $4, 8($5)
lw $4, -8($5)
lw $4, 32767($5)
lw $4, -32768($5)
lwl $4, 3($5)
lwr $4, 0($5)
sb $4, 0($5)
sh $4, 2($5)
sw $4, 4($5)
swl $4, 3($5)
swr $4, 0($5)
lw $t0, ($sp)
sw $ra, 28($sp)
ll $4, 8($5)
sc $4, 8($5)

# ---- register-to-register pseudo-instructions ----
nop
move $4, $5
move $a0, $v0
not $4, $5
neg $4, $5
negu $4, $5

# ---- li / la: the one- and two-instruction split ----
li $4, 0
li $4, 1
li $4, -1
li $4, 0x7fff
li $4, 0x8000
li $4, 0xffff
li $4, 0x10000
li $4, 0x12345
li $4, -32768
li $4, -32769
li $4, 0x7fffffff
li $4, -0x80000000
li $4, 0xffff0000
li $4, 0xffffffff
li $a0, 0x1230000
la $4, 0x12345
la $4, 8

# ---- system ----
syscall
syscall 3
break
break 7
break 7, 8
sync
sync 1
eret
teq $4, $5
tne $4, $5
tge $4, $5
tgeu $4, $5
tlt $4, $5
tltu $4, $5
teq $4, $5, 7
tne $4, $5, 1023
mfc0 $4, $12
mtc0 $4, $12
mfc0 $4, $12, 1

# ---- coprocessor 1 ----
mfc1 $4, $f0
mtc1 $4, $f12
lwc1 $f0, 8($4)
ldc1 $f2, 16($sp)
swc1 $f4, 0($5)
sdc1 $f6, 24($sp)
add.s $f0, $f2, $f4
add.d $f0, $f2, $f4
sub.s $f0, $f2, $f4
sub.d $f6, $f8, $f10
mul.s $f0, $f2, $f4
mul.d $f0, $f2, $f4
div.s $f0, $f2, $f4
div.d $f0, $f2, $f4
abs.s $f0, $f2
abs.d $f0, $f2
neg.s $f0, $f2
neg.d $f0, $f2
mov.s $f0, $f2
mov.d $f30, $f28
sqrt.s $f0, $f2
sqrt.d $f0, $f2
cvt.s.d $f0, $f2
cvt.s.w $f0, $f2
cvt.d.s $f0, $f2
cvt.d.w $f0, $f2
cvt.w.s $f0, $f2
cvt.w.d $f0, $f2
trunc.w.s $f0, $f2
trunc.w.d $f0, $f2
round.w.s $f0, $f2
ceil.w.s $f0, $f2
floor.w.s $f0, $f2
c.f.d $f0, $f2
c.un.s $f0, $f2
c.eq.s $f0, $f2
c.eq.d $f0, $f2
c.ueq.s $f0, $f2
c.olt.s $f0, $f2
c.ult.s $f0, $f2
c.ole.s $f0, $f2
c.ule.s $f0, $f2
c.lt.s $f0, $f2
c.lt.d $f0, $f2
c.nge.s $f0, $f2
c.le.s $f0, $f2
c.ngt.s $f0, $f2
